block.title: In-game enemy sprite sheet: dune worm, dust devil, husk crawler
block.positive: 16-bit SNES-era video game sprite sheet, pixel art style, bold dark navy outlines, saturated limited palette, laid out in a clean even grid on a flat deep warm-navy background color reference hex 0c1a3c, no gradients, no scenery, no text, no labels, no UI. Row one: DUNE WORM segments and head — four frames of a brass ring-plated boring worm head with a spiral drill maw, rising from a sand collar, mouth closed, mouth revving, mouth fired-open with a pink orb, and a dented damaged frame; beside them two loose body-ring segments for stacking the worm's length. Row two: DUST DEVILS — four frames of a twisting rust-colored vapor funnel with a hollow dark core and orbiting pebble specks, each frame rotating the shear bands a quarter turn so the spiral advances upward. Row three: HUSK CRAWLERS — four frames of a beetle-shaped walker drone, overlapping charcoal carapace plates, six stubby legs in a walk cycle, a dim red eye-bar under the shell lip, one frame with the shell flipped open showing a vulnerable violet core. Chunky crisp pixels, dithered brass highlights, side view facing left.
